2607.04912.title: Graph Representation Learning of Longitudinal Medical Imaging Trajectories for Treatment Response Prediction
2607.04912.paper_summary: In patients with breast cancer, pathological complete response (pCR) has been established as a clinically meaningful surrogate marker for long-term outcomes. While commonly treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT), effective treatment decision-making remains challenging, as therapeutic response can vary substantially across patients, calling for predictive models capable of accurately estimating individualized treatment response. To address this, we propose an imaging-based 3D spatio-temporal framework for treatment response prediction that integrates a state-of-the-art graph neural network with relational modeling of temporal interactions across timepoints alongside three novel complementary self-supervised treatment trajectory representation learning objectives. Experiments across a cohort of 585 patients from the public ISPY-2 dataset demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms both vision and self-supervised learning baselines across several classification metrics. Alongside establishing a breast cancer pCR prediction benchmark, we include a principled ablation of our method and further introduce and empirically assess the impact of the available number of DCE-MRI timepoints per patient trajectory and the inclusion of inter-scan time-differences. Overall, our study substantiates the utility of clinically meaningful longitudinal medical imagaging modeling for predicting NACT-induced pCR. We will publicly share our code repository and a user-friendly PyPI library for dataset curation upon publication, effectively promoting reproducible open-source research.
2607.04912.paper_summary_zh: 在乳腺癌患者中，病理完全反應（pCR）已被確立為一個臨床上有意義的替代標記，用於長期結果。雖然通常使用新輔助化療（NACT）進行治療，但有效的治療決策仍然具有挑戰性，因為治療反應在患者之間可能有顯著差異，這需要能夠準確估計個體化治療反應的預測模型。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個基於影像的3D時空框架，用於治療反應預測，該框架整合了一個最先進的圖神經網絡，並對時間點之間的時間互動進行關係建模，還包括三個新穎的互補自我監督治療軌跡表示學習目標。在來自公共ISPY-2數據集的585名患者的隊列中進行的實驗表明，我們的方法在幾個分類指標上顯著超越了視覺和自我監督學習的基準。除了建立乳腺癌pCR預測基準外，我們還對我們的方法進行了原則性的消融研究，並進一步介紹並實證評估每位患者軌跡中可用的DCE-MRI時間點數量及掃描間時間差的影響。總體而言，我們的研究證實了臨床上有意義的縱向醫學影像建模在預測NACT誘導的pCR方面的實用性。我們將在發表時公開分享我們的代碼庫和用戶友好的PyPI庫，以便於數據集的整理，有效促進可重複的開源研究。
